### **Title**  
Provide a concise and clear title for your pull request.  

Example:  
`Fix: Resolves issue with theme index creation in songs module`  

---

### **Description**  
Describe the changes you made in detail. Include the following:  
- The problem you solved or the feature you added.  
- The approach you used to implement the solution.  
- Any additional context or dependencies.  

Example:  
> **Issue:** Closes #123  
> This PR implements the functionality to create indexes based on themes for songs.  
> Added utility functions to group songs by themes and updated the database query logic to improve performance.  

---

### **Checklist**  
Ensure the following before submitting your pull request:  
- [ ] I have linked the relevant issue(s).  
- [ ] I have run the application locally and verified my changes.  
- [ ] I have added or updated tests (if applicable).  
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (if applicable).  
- [ ] I have adhered to coding standards and best practices.  

---

### **Testing**  
Provide details of how you tested your changes.  

Example:  
> - Ran the application locally and verified the theme indexes are created correctly.  
> - Verified that the existing database queries work as expected with the new indexes.  

---

### **Screenshots (if applicable)**  
Attach screenshots of the feature or bug fix in action.  

---

### **Additional Notes**  
Add any additional context, questions, or comments about your pull request.
